priority_topics.topic: Schwab Streamer WebSocket Reconnect Under High Jitter
priority_topics.summary: Team agreed to implement an exponential backoff with 3s jitter to avoid hammering the Schwab streaming gateway on reconnect.
priority_topics.consensus: Implement jittered backoff in SchwabStreamerService with companion reconnection unit test.
